no_recent: Create a vault or open an existing KDBX 4.0 file.
local: Local file • no account • no cloud sync
master_hint: Use a unique passphrase of at least 12 characters. There is no recovery key.
unlock_hint: Enter your master password to access this local file.
empty: A quieter place for your passwords
empty_hint: Add your first entry. Everything stays in your encrypted file.
select: Select an entry to see its details
title: Title
ambiguous: Include similar characters (0 O l I)
delete_confirm: Delete this entry? The deletion will be written when you save the vault.
draft_prompt: Keep the changes to this entry?
quit_locked: Unlock to save your encrypted draft, or discard it and quit.
session_lock: Also locks when Windows locks. Unsaved work stays encrypted in memory.
update_failed: Could not check for updates. The repository may have no release yet, or the network is unavailable.
integrity_failed: The download could not be verified. The installed application was not changed.
ready_restart: Update verified. Save your work, then restart to install.
update_privacy: Only the public release service is contacted. No passwords or vault data are sent.
format_limits: KDBX 4.0 · AES-256 or ChaCha20 · Argon2d/id 1.3 or AES-KDF. Password only. No key files, attachments, hardware keys, KDB/KDBX 3 or 4.1. Library writing is experimental.
memory_note: Owned secrets are cleared where possible. Memory copies, paging and a compromised operating system remain outside this guarantee. Keep an independent backup.
err_credentials: Incorrect master password, or the authenticated vault was modified.
err_corrupt: The file is damaged or incomplete. The original was not changed.
err_unsupported: This file uses an unsupported version, cipher, KDF or attachment. See Format support in Settings.
err_limit: The file or its KDF parameters exceed safe limits.
err_conflict: The file changed elsewhere. Export an encrypted copy, then reopen the original.
err_file: Could not access the file. Check its location and write permissions.
err_entry: Enter a title and choose a valid group. Groups must be empty before deletion.
err_password: Passwords must match and contain at least 12 characters.
err_random: Secure operating system randomness is unavailable.
cancelled: Cancelled; your changes are still here
lock_failed: Could not encrypt the draft. The vault has not locked. Save or export your work and try again.
encrypted_draft: Your unsaved work is encrypted in memory. Unlock to continue.
kdf_limits: Limits: file/XML 32 MiB; Argon2 256 MiB, 16 passes, 8 lanes and 1 GiB total memory-work; AES-KDF 10 million rounds; tree depth 64.
leave_prompt: Save all changes before leaving this vault?
err_recovered_conflict: The file changed during replacement. The other version was preserved here:
